newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks higher at open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were steady at the start of trading on Thursday, seeing some follow-through to Wednesday's 93-point Dow rally.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up eight points at 6,954 while the Nasdaq Composite was two higher at 1,331 and the S&P Index was up fractionally at 802.
The 30-year long bond off 2/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
